_comment: v1.5 hero run — 152M params (18L × 768d × 12h × 4KV, head_dim 64). Reuses the existing 15B-token data/smollm_mix. Beyond v1, this run adds: deeper architecture (18L vs 12L), seq_len 2048 (vs 1024), Muon hybrid optimizer (vs AdamW), WSD schedule (vs cosine), Liger fused linear+CE kernel, z-loss 1e-4, ReLU² FFN (vs SwiGLU), final logit soft-cap 30.0. Head_dim 64 avoids the liger-kernel 0.8.0 RoPE bug at head_dim 80. Tokens/step ≈ 1.06M (40 * 13 * 2048); 14000 steps → ~14.9B tokens. Direct comparison anchor: Pythia-160M (same width, 50% more depth); secondary: Pythia-410M token-matched. BS=40 is a safe default with ~12% mem headroom on A100 40GB; bump to BS=48 if calibration shows room (drop grad_accum to ~11 to keep tokens/step ~= 1M).
